comparison.objective: Extend an adjustable training handle and positively engage its detent pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Withdraw and hold a pin clear while changing length, then align and reengage the detent.
comparison.success_condition: Handle reaches the selected extension and the pin positively engages; early pin return is rejected, but numeric pose and engagement thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests coordinated pin withdrawal and re-latching in an adjustable mechanism, not sacrificial-feature fracture or recovery of released fragments. Missing numeric details do not make the objectives plausibly duplicative.
